usage: Train.py [-h] [--platform PLATFORM] --bin_fn BIN_FN
                [--chkpnt_fn CHKPNT_FN] --ochk_prefix OCHK_PREFIX
                [--maxEpoch MAXEPOCH] [--learning_rate LEARNING_RATE]
                [--exclude_training_samples EXCLUDE_TRAINING_SAMPLES]
                [--mini_epochs MINI_EPOCHS] [--enable_dwell_time]
                [--reuse_bin]
                [--random_validation | --validation_fn VALIDATION_FN]
                [--local_rank LOCAL_RANK] [--scale_lr]

Train a Clair3 model

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --platform PLATFORM   Sequencing platform of the input. Options:
                        'ont,hifi,ilmn', default: ont
  --bin_fn BIN_FN       Binary tensor input generated by Tensor2Bin.py,
                        supports HDF5 bin files
  --chkpnt_fn CHKPNT_FN
                        Input a model to resume training or for fine-tuning
  --ochk_prefix OCHK_PREFIX
                        Prefix for model output after each epoch
  --maxEpoch MAXEPOCH   Maximum number of training epochs
  --learning_rate LEARNING_RATE
                        Set the initial learning rate, default: 0.001
  --exclude_training_samples EXCLUDE_TRAINING_SAMPLES
                        Define training samples to be excluded
  --mini_epochs MINI_EPOCHS
                        Number of mini-epochs per epoch
  --enable_dwell_time   Enable dwell time for training, default: False
  --reuse_bin           Reuse 9-channel bin tensors by dropping the last
                        channel before training, default: False
  --random_validation   Use random sample of dataset for validation, default:
                        False
  --validation_fn VALIDATION_FN
                        Binary tensor input for use in validation: None
  --local_rank LOCAL_RANK
                        Local rank for distributed training (set by torchrun)
  --scale_lr            Scale learning rate by the number of GPUs, default:
                        False
